amp> c = population 8
c: 8 members, c{1..8}, all individuals
amp> a = population 8
a: 8 members, a{1..8}, all individuals
amp> t = population 8
t: 8 members, t{1..8}, all individuals
amp> o = population 8
o: 8 members, o{1..8}, all individuals
amp> cat = <c -> a -> t>
cat: state <c, a, t> and transition c -> a -> t
amp> inspect cat
cat: #1 state <c{1}, a{1}, t{1}>; #2 transition c{1} -> a{1} -> t{1}
amp> cot = ⟨c -> o -> t⟩
cot: state <c, o, t> and transition c -> o -> t
amp> inspect cot
cot: #3 state <c{2}, o{1}, t{2}>; #4 transition c{2} -> o{1} -> t{2}
amp> ta = <t -> a> ; <a, o>
ta: state <t, a> and transition t -> a and state <a, o>
amp> inspect ta
ta: #5 state <t{3}, a{2}>; #6 transition t{3} -> a{2}; #7 state <a{2}, o{2}>
amp> x = <c -> a
error: expected "->" or ">" after a
amp> x = <c -> >
error: expected a population name after "->", got >
amp> x = <c -> a, t>
error: expected "->" or ">" after a, got ,
amp> x = <c>
error: a state needs at least two populations
amp> inspect x
error: x is not declared
